thread:
Samantha Lee: Quick sync — seeing weird variance between our golden probes and the live bench for the same model. Throughput stable but latency jitter ~10–40ms across runs. Repro: bench commit abc123, batch_size=8, seq=512, quant=q4_0. Anyone else hit this?
Raj Patel: I noticed something similar yesterday. Could be sampling variance from the probe set or subtle tokenization differences. Can you paste one of the golden samples?
Samantha Lee: here's a reduced example:
```
system: You are a helpful assistant.
user: Summarize the key points of the following policy doc in 3 bullets.
```
Also using deterministic seed=42.
Liam O'Connor: FWIW that could also be KV-cache/warmup related — golden runs often start cold, runtime bench may have warm sessions. Try doing a small warmup prefix before measuring.
Samantha Lee: good call. bench run was cold. I can add a warmup but want to understand root cause too.
Jess Rivera: Another common culprit: mismatched quant/tokenizer between bench artifact and serving artifact. Confirmed quant tag q4_0? and tokenizer version?
Samantha Lee: model artifact hashes match and metadata shows quant: q4_0, but bench harness used tokenizer v0.9 and runtime moved to v1.0 last week — that could add a few tokens and change latencies.
infra-bot: Deploy log: bench-harness image rebuilt at ts=5087600000; includes tokenizer v1.0. If you want the previous behavior, use image tag bench:v5087590000.
Raj Patel: Proposed plan (quick):
  1) Add tokenizer_version assert in intake so we fail-fast on mismatch.
  2) Add a warmup step for golden probes to mimic runtime cache.
  3) Collect token-level timing traces (prefix vs decode) for 24h to spot hotspots.
Jess Rivera: on it — will add an ingest assertion like `assert meta['tokenizer_version']==runtime.tokenizer.version` and a pipeline warning + blocker for mismatch. PR shortly.
Liam O'Connor: I'll add a default 3-request warmup to the golden runner and a `golden_mode` flag to optionally emulate warm cache/long-lived sessions. Also adding a short script to run: `for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -X POST $BENCH_URL -d '{"prompt":"\n"}'; done`
Samantha Lee: thanks all — scheduled a re-run at 11:30 PT after the deploy + patches. I'll post before/after traces. :rocket:
Raj Patel: if traces still noisy we can add token-level sampling to the trace exporter and correlate with tokenizer deltas.
Jess Rivera: PR for ingest assert created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest/pull/487 — adds assert + human-friendly error.
Samantha Lee: awesome — will follow up after the run. TL;DR: tokenizer mismatch + warm cache are top suspects, fixes in flight. :thumbsup:
